title: 第6章 我要成亲了
slug: 恶毒女配又装纯禁欲大佬皆沦陷
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

结界内。

夜弦说道：“和铃，我要成亲了。”

他仔细盯着和铃的脸，不想放过她一丝一毫的表情变化。

和铃无所谓地说道：“你成亲跟我说做什么，我是你领导啊，成个亲还要跟我打报告。”

夜弦皱眉。

什么领导，什么报告，和铃她疯了吗？都开始说胡话了。

夜弦压着烦闷，问道：“你就不好奇我和谁成亲吗？”

“和铃，这个机会本来是你的……”

“咳咳！”和铃笑得呛到了气管，“夜弦，你是在搞笑吗？”

她就没见过这么自恋的人。

“真把自己当香饽饽了，谁见了都想啃两口啊，你放心，这个机会我不要，你爱给谁给谁，都与我和铃无关。”

舔狗系统着急道：【和铃，你真的要眼睁睁看着夜弦成亲吗？他要是成亲了，你再纠缠他，名声可就不好听了。】

【闭嘴。】

为了自己的前程，舔狗系统也不可能在这个时候闭嘴的。

【和铃，夜弦既然来找你，这就说明这门婚事他没有那么满意，他心里肯定是有你的位置的，你快开口叫他别成亲啊！】

【我可以给你换系统奖励，你想要什么，我尽量给你办。】

和铃眸光微微一动，在脑海里面和系统沟通：【把今日的日常任务奖励换成涅槃塑灵丹能办到吗？】

狗系统：【宿主，我们还是聊点现实的吧。】

和铃：【不聊。】

狗系统：【只能换成一道护体灵光。】

和铃：【好，成交。】

无视掉夜弦正说着话，和铃直接打断他：“你今天冷吗？”

夜弦愣了愣，磕磕绊绊道：“不，不冷……”

夜弦又自信起来。

果然，和铃还是在意他的。

之前的反常可能是欲擒故纵，想换一种方式吸引他的注意力。

【叮，今日舔狗任务已完成，奖励一道护体灵光。】

Within the boundary.

Ye Xian said: "He Ling, I'm getting married."

He stared at He Ling's face carefully, not wanting to miss the slightest change in her expression.

He Ling said nonchalantly: "What are you going to tell me about when you get married? I am your leader, and you have to report to me when you get married."

Ye Xian frowned.

What leadership, what report, and bell is she crazy?Everyone started talking nonsense.

Yexian suppressed his annoyance and asked, "Aren't you curious about who I am getting married to?"

"He Ling, this opportunity was originally yours..."

"Ahem!" He Ling choked on his trachea from laughing, "Yexian, are you kidding?"

She has never seen such a narcissistic person.

"You really treat yourself like a piece of cake. Everyone who sees it wants to take a bite of it. Don't worry, I don't want this opportunity. It has nothing to do with Ling and me if you give it to whomever you like."

Licking System said anxiously: [He Ling, do you really want to watch Ye Xian get married?If he gets married, your reputation will not be good if you pester him again.】

【Shut up.】

For the sake of its own future, it is impossible for the Licking System to shut up at this time.

[He Ling, since Ye Xian comes to see you, it means that he is not so satisfied with this marriage. He must have a place for you in his heart. Please tell him not to get married!】

[I can change the system rewards for you. Whatever you want, I will try my best to do it for you.】

He Ling's eyes moved slightly, and he communicated with the system in his mind: [Is it possible to replace today's daily task reward with the Nirvana Shaping Spirit Pill?】

Dog System: [Host, let’s talk about something realistic.】

He Ling: [No chat.】

Dog system: [It can only be replaced by a protective aura.】

He Ling: [Okay, deal.】

Ignoring what Ye Xian was saying, He Ling interrupted him directly: "Are you cold today?"

Ye Xian was stunned for a moment, then stumbled and said: "No, it's not cold..."

Ye Xian became confident again.

Sure enough, He Ling still cared about him.

The previous abnormality may have been due to playing hard to get, trying to attract his attention in another way.

[Ding, today's dog licking task has been completed, and a body-protecting aura will be rewarded.】
